concept: Custom CRM as the sticky note that doesn't fall off. One wall of a made-up firm's yellow sticky notes in handwriting (quotes, bookings, an invoice, a number), rendered in 3D (Blender) under raking light and shot from the left three ways. The wall of notes: this is a CRM, technically. Low under the bottom row: one has let go and is in mid-air, Ring Mrs Ridley back TODAY, its place on the wall empty. Then from the floor, across the heap of every yellow note: one blue Nexulabs note still on the wall. Warm grey plaster, note yellow, black ink and one brand blue; Newsreader bold with the last line in italic.
